content_html: Jeffrey: It looks like you need IE to create the site and manage it, but not to view it. I can view Sam Gentile’s new home site (see his recent blog post ‘Refurbished New Home Site’) in FireFox 2 just fine. Even if it’s not *quite* as bad as it originally sounds, it’s still bad. C’mon, in this day and age, to say IE-only is just silly. It seems weird though, because JS/AJAX development is so much easier in FireFox and such a pain in IE, I do all my Ajax/JS apps first in FireFox (using FireBug and other dev tools) and then figure out what’s broken in IE.
